name: holocron
title: Holocron
description: Explicitly share a Mac clipboard snapshot or selected Finder file with Holocron for ChatGPT.
author: amxv

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test

preferences.name: executablePath
preferences.title: Holocron CLI Executable
preferences.description: Leave blank for ~/.local/bin/holocron, or enter the absolute path to an installed Holocron CLI. Shell commands are not supported.

preferences.name: localConfigPath
preferences.title: Local Holocron Config
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to a Holocron local JSON config. Leave blank to use the CLI's existing private config reference.

commands.name: share-clipboard
commands.title: Share Clipboard with Holocron
commands.subtitle: Holocron
commands.description: Capture the current Mac text clipboard once and share it with Holocron for ChatGPT. This does not fill a remote computer clipboard.

commands.name: share-finder-file
commands.title: Share Selected Finder File with Holocron
commands.subtitle: Holocron
commands.description: Explicitly share one selected Finder UTF-8 file up to 10 MiB with Holocron for ChatGPT.
